name: Kinpatsu Gyaru
source: A shop assistant at MGSM, a fashionable clothing store in the local mall. Often called Kin-chan. Kouhai of [url=/c119223]Kinugawa Kaede[/url], and speaks casually to everyone but her. Likes ridiculing people. High voice. Unexpectedly sharp. Younger than [url=/c119221]Akino Yasuo[/url].
